beats.desc: the left hand presents the black exterior knob, its brass mounting posts and spindle pointing toward the round bored hole in the white door, while the right hand steadies the black interior knob against the other side of the door
the left hand pushes the exterior knob into the bore so its brass posts and spindle pass through the door and mate with the interior knob, seating the round rose flush against the door face

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt joins the two halves of a black knob lockset through a white door, guiding the exterior knob's brass posts and spindle into the bore to mate with the interior knob, working with both hands; the man
